meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: Claude 会套用「Setup-Conflict-Resolution」叙事框架，把原始数据整理成面向非技术受众的洞察报告，包含标题先行结论、可视化、影响估算与下一步行动建议。
howto.when: 当你向高管汇报、做季度业务回顾，或制作投资者演示，需要把数据讲成故事时使用。

say.text: 帮我把这份流失数据做成给高管看的故事报告
用对比故事框架分析 EMEA 和 APAC 该先进哪个市场
say.note: 给出加权评分表与推荐结论

say.text: 把这份月报改写成标题先行的一页数据故事
say.note: 输出标题、关键指标与行动建议

howto.what_en: Claude applies the Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative framework to turn raw data into insight reports for non-technical audiences, with headline-first conclusions, visuals, impact estimates and next steps.
howto.when_en: Use when presenting analytics to executives, creating quarterly business reviews, or building investor presentations where data must be told as a story.

say_en.text: Turn this churn data into an executive story report
Use the comparison framework to weigh EMEA vs APAC first
say_en.note: Returns a weighted scoring matrix and recommendation

say_en.text: Rewrite this monthly review as a one-page, headline-first data story
say_en.note: Gives headline, key metrics and actions
